# EDCS – Epigraphy Database Clauss / Slaby
## Welcome to the Epigraphic Database Clauss-Slaby (EDCS)
### The world’s largest database of Roman inscriptions
The Epigraphic Database Clauss-Slaby (EDCS) is the largest and most widely used international database of Roman inscriptions. With currently 543,239 recorded inscriptions and 170,807 drawings and photographs, it offers a digital research infrastructure that is unique in scope, depth, and accessibility within the field of epigraphy.

## Journal
The online journal (EDCS-J) is intended to publish short contributions to epigraphy as well as new inscriptions, additions to inscriptions, or new readings. Authors receive a PDF of their article, which is made publicly available on the EDCS-Journal download page and registered with a DOI. Authors are responsible for the image rights of any supplied figures. We welcome the submission of articles and open peer-review reactions to [Anne.Kolb@uzh.ch](mailto:Anne.Kolb@uzh.ch) .
